description: Survey Studio adds a full forms and survey builder to the Umbraco backoffice, built on SurveyJS - no separate SurveyJS license required. Editors design multi-page surveys, quizzes, and data-capture forms with reusable custom question types, data lists, and themes, then drive branching logic through a visual conditional workflow engine and score responses automatically. Forms are organized into folders and reusable templates, submissions are reviewed right in the backoffice, and a multi-tenant-ready data layer makes it a fit for agencies running many Umbraco sites from one install. Licensed commercial software - see LICENSE.txt.
title: Umbraco RedMorello Survey Studio
